## About

Three four-second shots (sea, forest, city) cut together, each with its own chapter card on
the track above, starting on the same frame as its shot. A card is one graphic clip: a large
outlined numeral (text with its fill off and a centered stroke), a gold tracked kicker, the
chapter name with a soft shadow and an italic line. Every card fades in after the cut and
fades out before the next one, so the cuts stay clean.
